description: Items 301–400 from UNSOURCED lists described as extracted from BNF Children 2023 / ICU Quick Drug Guide 2025. Pure repeats of earlier items (etomidate, tigecycline, eravacycline, plazomicin, delafloxacin, omadacycline, baloxavir; and in 351–400 calcipotriol, chloramphenicol eye drops, epoetin, darbepoetin, iron sucrose, ferric carboxymaltose, penicillamine, trientine) are omitted. Fixed doses are labelled 'Adult / age not stated'; weight-based doses 'Age not stated'. Doses that appear incorrect are NOT loaded. All notes unverified.
